entities.name: Query prenyltransferase
observations: 264 aa protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q8G7Y3 from Bifidobacterium longum.
Contains Pfam Prenyltransf domain PF01255.25 spanning residues 41-261.
Likely catalyzes Mg2+-dependent condensation of isopentenyl diphosphate with allylic prenyl diphosphates.
Closest exact annotation identifies an isoprenyl transferase involved in polyprenol biosynthesis; exact product-chain specificity should be treated as annotation-supported but substrate-dependent.
Predicted molecular mass is 30.24 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.34.

entities.name: Q8G7Y3
observations: Reviewed UniProt isoprenyl transferase from Bifidobacterium longum NCC 2705.
Catalyzes condensation of IPP with allylic pyrophosphates to generate terpenoid/polyprenyl diphosphates.
Binds two Mg2+ ions per subunit and is annotated as a homodimer.
Annotated with polyprenol biosynthetic process and prenyltransferase-related activities.
